body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Gain +1 Fortitude and resist your next 2 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Become Rallied until the start of your next turn.
Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Vow
rider.html: Vow: do not voluntarily move farther from a chosen visible enemy before your next turn. Spend this Authority when it damages you to reduce that Damage by 1; retreating first discards it.
